name: Four Seasons Resort Maldives at Landaa Giraavaru
positioning: Remote island resort with villas in the Baa Atoll UNESCO Biosphere Reserve, reached by seaplane
best_for: Travelers who want a remote island setting with wellness at AyurMa
Families wanting a kids' club on the island

facts.text: The resort is on the remote northern Baa Atoll, a UNESCO World Biosphere Reserve.
The resort is on the site of a former coconut plantation.
Blu Beach Club has a dinner menu by Michelin-distinguished Chef Nino Di Costanzo.
Al Barakat is the resort's overwater restaurant.
Café Landaa has a teppanyaki counter in the middle of a water garden.
Kuda Velaa Kids' Club offers supervised activities indoors and out.

highlights.text: The main pool is a 50-metre (164-foot) Olympic-size pool.
AyurMa is the resort's health and wellness haven.
Landaa is home to the Maldives' first Hologram Room.
Resident marine biologists oversee the resort's environmental programme.
The Water Sports Centre offers complimentary snorkels, masks, fins and kayaks.

considerations.text: Seaplane transfers operate during daylight hours only.
The last seaplane out of Landaa Giraavaru usually departs at 3:00 pm local time.
WhataHotel notes the remote location requires a seaplane transfer.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
